subject.title: fix(ci): shared Periphery gate honors ignore comments

question: After the queued shared-kit iOS and macOS scans complete, should this maintainer-labeled PR be accepted as the canonical generic handling for bare Periphery ignore comments?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the change deliberately defines a CI suppression boundary whose real scan behavior should be confirmed before landing.

options.title: Confirm scans, then merge
options.body: Accept the bounded adjacent-line filter if both shared Periphery scans pass and the historical ignored declarations no longer appear.

options.title: Narrow the contract further
options.body: Request a revised filter if the real scans show that the bare directive can suppress findings outside Periphery’s intended ignore semantics.

recommendation.title: Confirm scans, then merge
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded adjacent-line filter if both shared Periphery scans pass and the historical ignored declarations no longer appear.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the immediately related merged OpenClawKit/Periphery repairs and can confirm the intended scanner contract.
